[SWS_PER_00515]
⌈
ara::per::ReadAccessor::SetPosition shall
set the file position to the provided position. If the provided position is located out-
side of the current content of the file (including the position at the end of the file),
ara::per::ReadAccessor::SetPosition shall keep the previous file position
and return kInvalidPosition.
⌋
